uncertainObservations: The sword count is deliberately left null. I can individually resolve seven upright swords (four in the left group, three in the right), and there appears to be one further round pommel between the two large right-hand swords that I cannot confirm as a separate weapon. So: at least 7, possibly 8. I am not stating a single number.
The right group's hilts overlap each other at similar depths, which is the specific reason the count is unreliable there.
It cannot be determined whether the figure's eyes are open behind the blindfold, or whether her mouth is open.
Whether the winding pale line from the castle is a stream, a road or a flooded track is ambiguous.
The distant structure is read as a ruined fortification, but its architecture is too small and hatched to be certain it is not a rock outcrop.
The marks in the lower border corners may be a signature, plate number or decorative ticks.
